## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build:firefox`
- [ ] `npm run build:chrome`
- [ ] `npm run verify:build`

## Product and privacy review

- [ ] No hidden network request, analytics, telemetry, or remote code was added.
- [ ] New permissions, providers, storage, dependencies, and performance costs are disclosed above.
- [ ] Tests and relevant documentation were updated.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under MPL-2.0.
- [ ] I understand that only MOMISBACK can approve, merge, and release it.
